info.description: REST API for PetShop e-commerce platform
info.title: PetShop API

post.description: Authenticate an admin and return tokens with RBAC permissions
Exchange a valid admin refresh token for a new access token (rotation)

get.description: Returns a single category by its slug
Returns all shipping addresses for the authenticated customer

post.description: Add a new shipping address for the authenticated customer

put.description: Update an existing shipping address (partial update)

delete.description: Remove a shipping address belonging to the authenticated customer

patch.description: Mark an address as the default shipping address

post.description: Authenticate a customer and return access + refresh tokens
Revoke the provided refresh token. Works for both customer and admin.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token (rotation)

get.description: Returns the authenticated customer's cart with all items

post.description: Add a product to the cart. If the product already exists, quantity is incremented.

put.description: Set the quantity of a specific product in the cart

delete.description: Remove a specific product from the cart

get.description: Returns paginated order history for the authenticated customer

post.description: Create an order from the current cart. Decrements stock atomically within a transaction.

get.description: Returns a single order with items for the authenticated customer
Returns a paginated list of active products with optional filters
Returns a single product by its slug

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
